# `ext::gpu` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/gpu.lani#L3)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Native Linux x86_64 Vulkan 1.1 profile: buffers, RGBA8 textures, uniform/storage/image bindings, graphics and compute pipelines, retained command encoders, asynchronous submissions and X11/XWayland presentation. Explicit manual owners and creating-thread access. CPU access/destruction is Busy while commands retain resources; frame tickets include presentation completion and preserve ownership after presentation errors. Requires swapchain maintenance and trusted prevalidated SPIR-V. Eight native tests pass on RTX 3090 with required Khronos synchronization validation, exact shader/pixel readback and reached failures. Not a portable WebGPU implementation, performance result or untrusted shader safety layer.
